review.rationale: The supplied original specification and frozen Gold are coherent as independent planning expectations. REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003 consistently require exact-key counts from the current handler map, including duplicate registrations, external map/array mutations, wildcard isolation, and unchanged emitter and snapshot behavior. The exact writable scope covers the implementation/interface and both required regression files without forcing unnecessary edits. Repository configuration and the supplied upstream microbundle source support treating root declarations and dist as generated artifacts, with rebuilding required before root-entry verification. The two stable task keys, independent verification dependency, and required implementation/verification coverage agree with the PRD. Eligible implementer and verifier assignments are supported by the supplied active project-scoped trusted claims for the relevant API, TypeScript, shared-data/state, and testing capabilities; pending legacy claims and personas are not needed. A separate active project reviewer is configured for the earlier risk-review prerequisite. No material unresolved Decision is supplied for this case, so ready status and no blocking reasons are appropriate. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct source-manifest/evaluation digest domains and whitespace-only PRD normalization. The frozen model, policy, sampling, and budget identifiers are consistent. The preparation-time remaining-work fields in originalSpecification are superseded by the supplied frozen preview facts, rather than evidence of candidate execution. This review uses only the supplied pre-candidate inputs, accepts Service-calculated digest bindings as provided, and does not claim independent digest recomputation, execution, or human attestation.
